selection_rule: Bounded primary-source audit with inspectable wording, results and methods. Six cause-specific national adult polls from 2025 are retained. The Epstein disclosure measure was replaced with a February 2026 registered-voter accountability question because it directly measures demand for investigations and prosecutions, not because of its percentage. This deliberate timing/population exception is not a matched comparison or exhaustive poll inventory.

source_documents.verified: Overall responses on p. 3 visually checked; methods p. 16. Replaces disclosure finding in active materials; previous source retained for provenance.

additional_sources.verified: Browser-rendered exact question and August2025 results; article methods independently extracted.

editorial_decisions: Do not pool the percentages: constructs, questions, modes, populations and months differ.
Use AP-NORC published Legal NET64 for abortion, not rounded sum63 or Gallup pro-choice identity51.
Climate concern is an indirect proxy, not climate-policy support.

Use Navigator February2026 72% demand for more investigations/prosecutions in headline and comparison. Retain Reuters/Ipsos 69% as separately labelled supporting evidence. 2025 event counts are mostly disclosure demands, not a prosecution-protest count. No highest-percentage claim.
evidence_storage: Primary PDF snapshots and extracted text retained outside the site in the above-the-law opinion-audit workspace.
